hook: Nothing can drive across the Crimean Bridge
reel_hook: A key bridge to Crimea is cut

slides.title: Crimean Bridge road cut
slides.image_prompt: A long road bridge over a dark sea at dusk, a broken gap in the roadway, smoke drifting, empty lanes and a rail arch nearby
slides.label: WORLD
points: WHAT HAPPENED
Ukraine struck the Crimean Bridge two nights in a row.
WHY IT MATTERS
Kyiv says no car can cross; traffic is suspended.
FOR YOU
Little changes for you directly, but a key Russia–Crimea road link is cut.
slides.body: Ukraine struck the Crimean Bridge two nights in a row. Kyiv says no car can cross; traffic is suspended. Little changes for you directly, but a key Russia–Crimea road link is cut.

slides.title: Trump, Xi, Putin: one table
slides.image_prompt: Three empty chairs around a round wooden table with three teacups, a city skyline glowing through a large window at dusk
slides.label: POLITICS
points: WHAT HAPPENED
Trump meets Xi and Putin together Thursday in Shenzhen.
WHY IT MATTERS
First-ever three-way talks; nukes and Iran on the agenda.
FOR YOU
Watch Thursday: Trump also floated meeting Kim, not confirmed by the White House.
slides.body: Trump meets Xi and Putin together Thursday in Shenzhen. First-ever three-way talks; nukes and Iran on the agenda. Watch Thursday: Trump also floated meeting Kim, not confirmed by the White House.

slides.title: Iran drones target US radar
slides.image_prompt: A white military radar dome on a desert base at night, bright streaks of intercepted drones fading in the dark sky
slides.label: WORLD
points: WHAT HAPPENED
Iran fired drones at a US radar base in Bahrain.
WHY IT MATTERS
Intercepted, no damage, amid talks via Oman and Qatar.
FOR YOU
The nearly nine-month US-Iran war keeps Gulf shipping and oil routes tense.
slides.body: Iran fired drones at a US radar base in Bahrain. Intercepted, no damage, amid talks via Oman and Qatar. The nearly nine-month US-Iran war keeps Gulf shipping and oil routes tense.

slides.title: US tightens AI chip exports
slides.image_prompt: A shiny silicon chip locked inside a glass box with a heavy padlock, a falling red arrow made of light behind it
slides.label: TECHNOLOGY
points: WHAT HAPPENED
US now needs licences for AI chips to 5 more countries.
WHY IT MATTERS
It targets China renting compute abroad; Nasdaq fell 2.49%.
FOR YOU
If you hold tech funds, expect swings: Nvidia reports earnings this week.
slides.body: US now needs licences for AI chips to 5 more countries. It targets China renting compute abroad; Nasdaq fell 2.49%. If you hold tech funds, expect swings: Nvidia reports earnings this week.

slides.title: Christmas Island turns red
slides.image_prompt: Thousands of bright red crabs crossing a tropical road and forest floor toward the sea, morning light
slides.label: CURIOSITY
points: WHAT HAPPENED
Millions of red crabs began their annual migration.
WHY IT MATTERS
It sweeps across Australia's Christmas Island every year.
FOR YOU
Nothing to do but enjoy it: nature's red carpet is back for another year.
slides.body: Millions of red crabs began their annual migration. It sweeps across Australia's Christmas Island every year. Nothing to do but enjoy it: nature's red carpet is back for another year.
